name: Bastion
tips: Bastions have yellow kneecaps on all of their leg joints and a yellow cylinder on their rear that Raiders can shoot to deal critical damage. Shooting these areas is the fastest way to destroy it. Destroying its rear canister or any of the leg joints stuns it for a short time, making this stun window a good time to shoot it. Destroying the canister also peels back its rear plate, revealing its true weak spot, a large barrel-like part that, when shot, deals major damage to the Bastion. Blaze Grenades and, to a lesser extent, Snap Blast Grenades are also an effective way of dealing damage. Deadline can also instantly defeat a Bastion when deployed near the canister.

name: Leaper
tips: As their name might suggest, the primary way Leapers attack is by quickly leaping at Raiders in an attempt to crush them, dealing heavy damage even if the Leaper did not land directly on top of a Raider. The Leaper is very accurate, and is known to crush Raiders even when they were sprinting away at full speed. Blaze Grenades are a cheap and easy method of dealing with Leapers. Throw one grenade directly onto the Leaper and wait for it to burn out. Once the burn stops, throw another. Afterward, the Leaper can be finished with one or two shots from a Heavy Ammo weapon.

name: Bombardier
tips: Bombardiers have yellow kneecaps on all of their leg joints and a yellow cylinder on their rear that Raiders can shoot to deal critical damage. Shooting the kneecaps impairs its mobility and exposes unarmored inner sections for increased damage. Destroying the rear cylinder can disable the Bombardier quickly. The Bombardier is accompanied by Spotters that mark Raider positions for precise mortar targeting. Eliminate these first to make it disoriented. The Bombardier becomes vulnerable immediately after firing its artillery, creating a good time to attack. Both Spotter drones will respawn after being destroyed. It is also good to note that one well-placed Deadline near its canister will destroy it in one mine.

name: Bully
tips: Shooting the weak points on its legs will make them eventually explode. This hinders the Bully's movement greatly. When using its shotgun, the Bully will open up the armor plating on its head, revealing yellow weak points, which can be shot for great amounts of damage. If sufficiently damaged, it will explode and fly off, leaving only the defenseless body of the Bully stumbling around. However, doing this is dangerous as there is little time before the shotgun fires, and the head has a lot of health.

name: Comet
tips: The Comet can be taken down by two simple methods. You can utilize 2–3 Seeker Grenades and strip away the armor of the Comet to the point of destroying it without damaging the igniter. When the Comet begins to charge it will eventually split open the armor shell exposing the innards, its weakspot, and the middle point is shot directly before the Comet explodes it will destroy the unit. Failure to destroy the Comet before it explodes will result in a shockwave type of explosion that deals a fair amount of damage. With a light shield equipped with full health and shield charge it will reduce the shield to about 1/4 charge remaining and similar health levels. When the Comet self implodes, it damages the igniter and while it looks like two pieces drop for searching only the "ring" part is searchable usually producing generic ARC parts (e.g., Alloy). If you are successful in destroying the Comet before the implosion there will be two pieces to search with the "core" piece containing the Igniter. As of right now it seems to ALWAYS drop the igniter if destroyed properly.

name: Fireball
tips: Fireballs open their front panel when attacking, exposing their unarmored core. Although the core is weak and can be destroyed by any weapon, the shell that covers it as a Fireball is patrolling is quite strong and requires a Medium Ammo or Heavy Ammo weapon to pierce it. Light Ammo weapons are ineffective against its shell and will bounce off. The easiest ways to deal with a Fireball is either by waiting for its front panel to open and shooting its core or using a hard-hitting weapon like a Ferro or Anvil to pierce its shell.

name: Firefly
tips: Upon entering combat mode, the Firefly extends its flamethrower, exposing an unarmored yellow fuel tank that takes increased damage. It then closes the distance to its target, scorching Raiders within range and dealing damage over time. The Firefly uses four thrusters for flight and stabilization, all protected by thick armor. Destroying multiple thrusters destabilizes the drone, causing it to lose control of its flight. In this state, each collision with the environment inflicts heavy damage, often permanently disabling or destroying the machine. When destroyed, the Firefly ignites the surrounding area for a short duration.

name: Hornet
tips: Upon entering combat mode, the Hornet aims a red laser at its target before firing a single stun round. This projectile stuns Raiders for a short duration and drains their shields. The Hornet uses four thrusters for flight and stabilization, with only the forward thrusters protected by thick armor. Destroying multiple thrusters destabilizes the drone, causing it to lose control of its flight. In this state, each collision with the environment inflicts heavy damage, often permanently disabling or destroying the machine. Stun rounds are relatively slow projectiles that are dodged with good timing. Destroyed Hornets are good sources of Medium Ammo. Medium or Heavy Ammo is ideal for puncturing its armor. A Lure Grenade can buy enough time to escape persistent swarms.

name: Hydra
tips: The Frigate's external hull has areas that Raiders can hide behind to avoid the Hydra's bullet barrage allowing Raiders to take pot shots at the Hydra when it finishes firing. The same goes for the internals of the Emperor, which have places to hide behind when the Hydra is firing. The rear section of the Hydra is unarmored and directly exposes its yellow weak points, allowing for it to be killed quicky if it is distracted. Raiders can fully avoid the Hydra's bullet barrage by standing right in front in the middle of it between the two gun segments, as the gun segments will not be able to aim and fire at the Raider. However, this leaves you vulnerable to wind currents, other ARC or Raider gunfire. Because the Hydra is heavily armoured, it is often recommended to try avoiding it instead of fighting it directly, as it can be worked around efficiently most of the time.

name: Matriarch
ability: Gas Grenades, Flashbangs, Energy Shield, Summons ARC
tips: High Ground/Cover If its children are unable to protect it, the fight becomes trivial. Examples of good spots: Spaceport - Control Tower A6 and the Launch Towers Dam Battleground - Electrical Substation for cover Blue Gate - On top of Reinforced Reception with deployable barricades Weak Points Don't target the legs, target its faceplates until they break off, then its big, red, glowing core will be exposed Attack Pattern Only attack that really hurts is its rocket barrage, the rest you can brush off relatively fine When its energy shield comes up, hold fire till it falls; or if you fancy your chances, slip inside the shield and take shots at its now-exposed core

name: Pop
tips: Upon activating combat mode, the Pop rolls at high speed toward its target while emitting a loud rhythmic beep. This signal increases in frequency as the Pop nears the Raider, culminating in a short delay before detonation. Raiders caught within the blast radius sustain significant damage to both shields and health. With just seconds to react before it explodes, switching to a fast-firing Weapon is ideal for destroying the Pop at close range. The Pop is usually unable to jump or climb obstacles, but it occasionally finds a way to surprise even seasoned Raiders. <!--Some Pops and Fireballs have been seen climbing walls and many have hit bumps and been launched into the air as if it jumped.--> Running straight pass the Pop at full speed is enough to get the Pop to detonate while not getting hurt having it waste it's explosive charge

name: Queen
ability: Laser Beam, Ground Slam, EMP Pulse

name: Rocketeer
tips: The Rocketeer is a deadly ARC that, when engaged without sufficient cover, will quickly end in your demise. Before fighting, seek shelter in buildings or behind substantial cover. Aim for the thrusters while focusing on two in particular. If you manage to get higher than it or to ride the Rocketeer, you can shoot or stick a grenade to the top of its thrusters, since they don't have any armor. Another way to effectively damage the Rocketeer is shooting off its "eyebrow" preferably with a high ARC Armor Penetration stat, then shooting the weak point on top of it with a high fire rate or low reload time weapon. Landing a few Snap Blast Grenades on top of it can take it out easily as well. Similar to other flying ARC, destroying two of its thrusters will cause it to fall towards the ground. When falling from a high enough height, it can be instantly destroyed by its own momentum. Any flying ARC that is stuck on the ground long enough will burst into flames. It is possible to weaponize a Lure Grenade when fighting a Rocketeer as well as another ARC simultaneously - sticking the grenade to another ARC will cause the Rocketeer to attack and damage that ARC. When the Rocketeer's laser disappears (signaling a full lock-on), do one of the following to dodge its attack: Dodge Roll Get behind cover Use caution, as its rockets still do splash damage, so they can still hit you in some circumstances, even if you are behind cover. It may also be nice to note that 1 Showstopper grenade will take this ARC to the ground for a few seconds if you hit a thruster, allowing the Raider to attach mines to it or ride it. Hitting the core will stun it temporarily instead, but it will remain in the sky. If you manage to hide from its field of view after being targeted, the Red Scanner Behavior Mode (Combat) will last about 20 seconds before transitioning to the Yellow Scanner Behavior Stage (Alert), which lasts about the same amount of time. When it reaches the Blue Scanner Behavior Stage (Patrol), you can also observe its thrusters recovering from an inclined position to a straight position.

name: ARC Surveyor
tips: The Surveyor is most vulnerable during transmission, when its core is exposed and it is stationary. It will abort the transmission and roll away at high speed the moment it detects a threat. Stunning the Surveyor with a Hornet Driver or Showstopper prevents it from escaping or protecting its core, leaving it vulnerable to powerful explosives such as Heavy Fuze Grenades. As the Surveyor takes damage, its armored panels can break off and be looted. Heavy Ammo is more effective at shedding its armor plating than most other Ammo types.

name: Sentinel
tips: The Sentinel will aim a thick orange laser at the Raider while tracking their movement. After a short time, multiple lasers will converge onto the target, indicating the Sentinel is about to fire. Once the lasers converge onto the target, it will fire a Heavy Ammo round after a short delay, dealing major damage. If the firing lasers converge after the target has left line of sight, it will fire at their last known location. The Sentinel has significant targeting range, don't assume you're safe because you're far away. When fighting a Sentinel, find solid cover. Its reaction time and fire rate are relatively slow, and it can therefore be shot at faster than it reacts. Aim for the yellow canister on the swivel arm to deal increased damage. Attacks can be avoided by Dodge Rolling, sliding into cover, moving behind cover, staying out of sight for extended periods.

name: Shredder
tips: The Shredder excels in closed quarters, like the halls of Stella Montis. Fires a multi-round burst of shrapnel in all directions as its primary attack, dealing heavy area damage in enclosed spaces. Periodically stops to “charge up” and then releases a larger blast/shrapnel cone; this charge gives a short window for counterplay, but is very dangerous if caught in the open. It pursues players to close distance and favors engagements where cover and corners limit player escape routes. The Shredder's propulsion / thruster units (the blue jet / jet-propeller) are consistent weak points players can target for higher damage and to stagger it. Explosives (Trigger 'Nade, snap/fuse grenades, and other area explosives) are highly effective, especially when used during or just after the Shredder's charge animation. Luring it through a doorway with a well placed Jolt Mine is also an easy way to get hits on the thrusters, as it will be stunned for a few seconds.

name: Skulker
tips: It can be easily destroyed with a single Hullcracker shot or destroyed with explosives like Seeker Grenades. Its thrusters can be destroyed relatively easy, and destroying one will inhibit the Skulker's movement greatly. Destroying two of its thrusters fully immobilizes it, similarly to drone ARC. Additionally, the Skulker's aim drops off at range and it doesn't feature fast movement speed, so outrunning it is often possible if you can cut line of sight quickly.

name: Snitch
tips: The Snitch relies on four unarmored thrusters for flight and stabilization. Destroying multiple thrusters in any combination will destabilize the drone, causing it to lose flight control and spiral into the ground. Each collision with the environment inflicts heavy damage, with a high probability of permanently disabling or destroying the machine. A few well-placed shots with a Weapon that fires Medium or Heavy Ammo is usually enough to destroy a Snitch before it begins calling for reinforcements. Hiding in heavy foliage may be enough to avoid being spotted by its scanner. Reinforcements are only guaranteed to appear after the Snitch begins the third in its series of calls. Snitches become significantly harder to hit when their thrusters are destroyed, as their flight becomes erratic and unpredictable.

name: Spotter
tips: The Spotter itself isn't a direct threat to you, but it can enable the Bombardier to engage you from very far distances, as well as from cover that would otherwise prevent the Bombardier from engaging. Killing both Spotters can "blind" the Bombardier, but the Spotters will eventually respawn, so it's ill-advised to do so constantly, as you will waste ammo or items to remove it for only a short period of time. The Spotter can be nullified by using a variety of tactics that abuse the fact that it doesn't directly attack. First, you can get into a building that the Bombardier can't shoot into. This makes it to where even though the Spotter is actively targeting you, the Bombardier can't use the Spotter in order to shoot at you. Next, you can put a wall or object that breaks the line of sight of the Spotter, breaking the beam and forcing the Spotter to reacquire you. Last, you can use Quick Use items in order to blind, stun, or disorient the Spotter in order to get away or get around it. However, keep in mind that the Spotter will also alert other ARC to your location, which could trap you in between several threats at once.

name: Tick
tips: When in its aggressive state, the Tick will make a robotic shuffling sound prior to it lunging toward the Raider's head. It will latch itself onto the Raider, slowly draining health and shield. Hold [interact] to dislodge the Tick. Once dislodged, the Tick will run along the ground to escape, and may try to lunge at you again. The Tick can be often be heard before it's seen, spawning dormant at first on the ceilings or in the rafters of buildings and making plenty of noise as they jump down to aggress. The Tick takes one hit from a Raider Tool to destroy, allowing Raiders to save ammo by destroying it with a melee.

name: ARC Turbine
ability: Mine deployment, Ground stun, Lightning strike
tips: When provoked, the ARC Turbine will deploy cluster missiles that initiate a lightning strike shortly after impact. This attack does a very high amount of damage and additionally stuns raiders, similar to naturally occurring lightning or the Hornet's stun weapon. Occasionally, the Turbine will stop drifting randomly and spray out a small field of proximity-activated mines into the ground beneath it, before showing cracks in the heavy armor, which heralds its descent to the ground. Once landed, the "turbine" section will be visible through the armor gaps as a result of the landing gear being deployed. It can still fire off cluster lightning in this state, so caution is required when attacking. The weak point of the ARC Turbine is the spinning yellow "tanks", only visible in the gaps left by the landing gear while it is on the ground. Using a Jupiter 150-200 meters away from the Turbine is an easy way of destroying it, as the lightning attack wont be able to reach you, and the Jupiter can pierce its heavy armor. When using any other weapon, either wait until the Turbine has landed, then take shots at its weak point(s), or aim for the top of the Turbine. Hitting its heavy armor will barely do any damage.

name: Turret
tips: When in its aggressive state, it will lock onto the Raider and fire a constant stream of bullets, dealing moderate damage. If the Raider leaves its line of sight, it will fire at their last known location for a short time. The Turret has no armor plating and can be quickly destroyed using only a few bullets from any Ammo type.

name: Vaporizer
tips: The Vaporizer is a deadly ARC that, when engaged without sufficient cover, will quickly end in your demise. Before fighting, seek shelter in buildings or behind substantial cover. Shooting the underside of the Vaporizer will knock off a small rectangular panel, exposing its core. The Vaporizer will attack with its line of sight laser beam leaving pools of burning fire wherever the beam contacts. Attempting to throw seeking or other projectile grenades such as the Seeker Grenade or the Wolfpack will trigger the defensive energy shield similar to that of the one found on the Matriarch. Once active, the shield will block all kinds of projectile damage, including small arms. As soon as the shield drops, the vaporizer will be unable to use its shield again for a short time creating an opening for attack. It's a good strategy to trigger the shield first, then use your seeking or other high damage weapons after.

name: Wasp
tips: Upon entering combat mode, the Wasp aims a red laser at its target before unleashing a volley of light projectiles. It hovers momentarily to stabilize its aim before quickly repositioning. The Wasp uses four thrusters for flight and stabilization. Destroying multiple thrusters destabilizes the drone, causing it to lose control of its flight. In this state, each collision with the environment inflicts heavy damage, often permanently disabling or destroying the machine. Destroyed Wasps are good sources of Light Ammo. Wasps become significantly harder to hit when their thrusters are destroyed, as their flight becomes erratic. A Lure Grenade can buy enough time to escape persistent swarms.
